content.text:
name: 'OpenCulturas - Map'
type: module
core_version_requirement: ^11
description: 'Provides a dynamic leaflet map for OpenCulturas'
package: OpenCulturas
version: 3.0.x-dev
project: openculturas
dependencies:
  - 'drupal:media'
  - 'leaflet:leaflet'
  - 'leaflet:leaflet_markercluster'
  - 'openculturas:openculturas_slimselect_bef'

configure: openculturas_map.settings_form

config_devel:
  install:
    - openculturas_map.settings
    - views.view.oc_map_dates
    - views.view.oc_map_locations
=== FAQ ===
name: 'OpenCulturas - Frequently Asked Questions'
type: module
core_version_requirement: ^11
description: 'Manages configuration of questions for a FAQ page.'
package: OpenCulturas
version: 3.0.x-dev
project: openculturas
dependencies:
  - 'drupal:field'
  - 'drupal:node'
  - 'drupal:pathauto'
  - 'drupal:taxonomy'
  - 'drupal:views'
  - 'field_permissions:field_permissions'
  - 'simple_sitemap:simple_sitemap'
  - 'viewfield:viewfield'

config_devel:
  install:
    - core.entity_view_mode.node.synopsis
    - field.storage.node.field_detailed_question
    - field.storage.node.field_faq_category
    - field.storage.taxonomy_term.field_related_faq_view_ref
    - node.type.faq
    - pathauto.pattern.faq_all_languages
    - pathauto.pattern.faq_term_all_languages
    - simple_sitemap.bundle_settings.default.node.faq
    - simple_sitemap.bundle_settings.default.taxonomy_term.faq_category
    - taxonomy.vocabulary.faq_category
  optional:

observation.command: cd /workspace; cat profile/modules/custom/openculturas_map/openculturas_map.info.yml; echo "=== FAQ ==="; cat profile/modules/custom/openculturas_faq/openculturas_faq.info.yml | head -30
